map.8项问卷筛查阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停(OSA)风险，判断是否需进一步多导睡眠监测(PS: 8-item questionnaire screening for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) risk to decide whether polysomnography (PSG) is needed
map.📖 查看「OSA STOP-BANG 筛查器 使用指南」: 📖 View the OSA STOP-BANG Screener user guide
map.STOP-BANG 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停筛查 = 打鼾 + 白天疲倦 + 观察到呼: STOP-BANG OSA screen = snoring + daytime tiredness + observed apnea + hypertension + BMI >35 + age >50 + neck circumference >40 cm + male, 1 point each, max 8; <=2 low risk, 3-4 moderate, >=5 high risk OSA.
map.S — 打鼾声响(关上门可闻): S - Snoring loud (heard through a closed door)
map.OSA可能性低，结合临床随访: Low OSA likelihood; follow up clinically
map.强烈建议PSG，围术期需警惕: PSG strongly advised; caution in the perioperative period
map.提示：STOP-BANG ≥3分提示中重度 OSA 风险升高；男性、BMI>35: Note: STOP-BANG >=3 indicates raised risk of moderate-severe OSA; when two of male sex, BMI >35 and neck circumference >40 cm are present, sensitivity for moderate-severe OSA is higher. Perioperative screening is especially important. Clinical reference only.
map.>35+年龄>50+颈粗+性别男=8 分→高危 OSA。: >35 + age >50 + thick neck + male = 8 points -> high-risk OSA.
map.0–2 分低危；3–4 分中危，建议睡眠监测。: 0-2 low risk; 3-4 moderate risk, sleep study advised.
map.几分做监测？: What score warrants a sleep study?
map.中高危(≥3)建议多导睡眠图确认。: Moderate-high risk (>=3) should be confirmed by polysomnography.
map.STOP-BANG 对中重度 OSA 灵敏度高，阴性可较放心排除。: STOP-BANG is highly sensitive for moderate-severe OSA; a negative result reasonably excludes it.
map.OSA(STOP-BANG)筛查器，8项问卷筛查阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停高风险，包括打: OSA (STOP-BANG) Screener: an 8-item questionnaire screening for high OSA risk including snoring, tiredness, apnea, hypertension, BMI, age, neck circumference and sex. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
